title: Okwebaka Okusukka Ebiseera
intro: Teebereza ekiseera ng’amazima gasirikiddwa era abakkiriza ne bayigganyizibwa. Ekibinja ekitono kyalonda okudda emabega okusinga okwewaayo, nga kifuna obuddukiro mu bifo ebisinga obutasuubirwa — ekifo ekyandifuuse ekifo kyabwe eky’okuwummulamu okumala ebyasa ebisukka ku kubalibwa. Bwe baasembayo okuzuukuka, ensi yali ekyuse nga ebeetoolodde. Emyoyo gino egy’okwebaka be baani?
clues: Twali bavubuka ababeera mu kibuga eky’edda.
Ekitundu kyaffe kyasaba tusinza ku mabbali gaabwe, naye ne tugaana.
Twadduka mu kibuga nga tunoonya obuddukiro eri abo abaali bawakanya enzikiriza zaffe.
Munnaffe omwesigwa ow’amagulu ana yasigala ku mulyango oguyingira mu kifo we twakweka.
Allah yatusuza okumala emyaka ebikumi bisatu mu mwenda.
Bwe twasembayo okuzuukuka, ekibuga kyaffe edda ekyali kiyigganyizibwa kyali kifunye okukkiriza.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
